title: A Yahoo FX pair symbol (EURUSD=X) gets the .NS suffix under the IN session region and 404s not_found on /quotes
repro: Own sidecar :52336 at 68d5573a (seed data, region IN): curl http://127.0.0.1:52336/quotes/EURUSD%3DX -> 404 not_found; sidecar log shows yfinance asked for '$EURUSD=X.NS: possibly delisted'. Same 404 on the shared :52152, so it predates fix-r1 and is outside rc1-drive-failure-inducer:1/:2 (the fix's alphabet rule did not fire; the YFTickerMissingError class did). Pre-existing, not a fix-r1 regression.

title: Copilot's after-research reply template ('Built you a brief on NVDA — it's at the top of the cockpit') is unconditional on review mode, so the local model can still narrate a staged auto-brief as published (the runtime staged notice does fire)
repro: Own sidecar :52336 at 68d5573a, vy.py invoke copilot 'research KPIT Technologies' --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b (default ask autonomy): the model calls only research, the runtime autobrief is staged, and the notice 'Staged for your review, not applied yet: publish_brief KPITTECH' fires. The model still replies 'Built you a brief on KPIT Technologies — it's at the top of the cockpit…'. The local model gave the 'proposed' reply in 1 of 2 research-only runs; the hosted gpt-4o-mini did in 2 of 2.
